question: The first edition of the Khelo India Para Games was organised in ______, featuring seven events across multiple Delhi venues.
solution:
The correct answer is __**2023-11-30T18:30:00.000Z**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **first edition of the Khelo India Para Games** was organized on **2023-11-30**. This date signifies the initiation of a historic event dedicated to promoting inclusivity in sports for para-athletes.
 
• The event featured **seven sports competitions** that were conducted across multiple venues in **Delhi**, showcasing the commitment to providing equal opportunities for para-athletes.
 
• This initiative is a part of the broader **Khelo India program**, which aims to strengthen grassroots sports and create a platform for athletes to excel nationally and internationally.
 
• The **Khelo India Para Games** is a step forward in achieving inclusivity by encouraging para-athletes to participate in competitive sports and gain recognition for their skills.
 
• The event was aimed at promoting the importance of sports among individuals with disabilities and offering them a platform to display their talents. *Hence, the correct date is **2023-11-30T18:30:00.000Z**.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Khelo India Program:**

 
 
• The **Khelo India initiative** was launched by the Government of India in **2018** to promote sports culture in the country and identify young talent for better training opportunities.
 
• It includes multiple programs and competitions aimed at enhancing sports infrastructure, conducting training, and encouraging participation in sports events across the country.
 
 
 
• **Para Games under Khelo India:**
 
 
• The **Khelo India Para Games** is an extension of the Khelo India program, specifically designed to provide a platform for para-athletes to showcase their talent and skills.
 
• This event aligns with the vision of inclusivity, encouraging people with disabilities to participate in sports and improve their physical and mental well-being.
 
 
 
• **Key Features of the 2023 Khelo India Para Games:**
 
 
• The event featured **seven sports disciplines**, including athletics, wheelchair basketball, badminton, and swimming, among others.
 
• Various venues in **Delhi** were used to accommodate the games, ensuring accessibility and convenience for the participants.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Significance of Khelo India Para Games:**

 
 
• The event highlights the Government of India’s commitment to creating an **inclusive sports environment** for individuals with disabilities.
 
• It also helps in identifying talented para-athletes who can represent India in international competitions such as the **Paralympics**.
 
 
 
• **Future Prospects:**
 
 
• The success of the **2023 Khelo India Para Games** is expected to inspire more such initiatives and foster greater participation in sports by para-athletes.
 
• The event serves as a stepping stone for para-athletes to achieve recognition at both the **national and international levels**.
